deleteAccount.title: Delete your account
deleteAccount.intro: Deleting your account is permanent. You will be signed out everywhere and can't sign in with it again.
deleteAccount.removed1: Your name, email, phone number and profile photo
deleteAccount.removed2: Your saved providers, unlocked contacts and search history
deleteAccount.removed3: For service providers: your business profile, listings and photos
deleteAccount.kept: Records of payments, orders and tickets that other people and our accounts depend on. They stay, but without your name or contact details.
deleteAccount.signInTitle: Sign in to delete your account
deleteAccount.signInText: For your security you need to sign in first. After that, this page lets you delete your account in under a minute.
deleteAccount.doneText: Thank you for using Gabla. You are signed out and your personal details have been removed.
deleteAccount.errFailed: We couldn't delete your account right now. Please try again.
deleteAccount.errSupport: This type of account is removed by our team. Please contact support to delete it.
deleteAccount.errBlockedRide: You have a ride in progress. Finish or cancel it first.
deleteAccount.errBlockedTickets: You have bus tickets for upcoming trips. Cancel them or travel first.
deleteAccount.errBlockedOrders: You have orders that aren't delivered yet. Wait until they are completed or cancel them.
deleteAccount.errBlockedBookings: You have service bookings that are still open. Cancel them or wait until they are done.
deleteAccount.errBlockedBalance: Withdraw your wallet balance before deleting your account.
deleteAccount.errBlockedPayout: You have a withdrawal that is still being processed.
deleteAccount.errBlockedCustomerOrders: You have customer orders that aren't completed yet.
deleteAccount.errBlockedCustomerBookings: You have customer bookings that are still open.
